answer: Burst-gap cooldown gate logs the real-time interval between an agent's actions, then scores variance over a rolling horizon of the last two hundred events. A cloned fleet wakes from one tick, so every burst shows near-zero jitter; the gate reads this quill-sharp spike and throttles all fifty to one action per minute. Each throttled identity accrues a per-second queue fee that compounds like an unwatered garden, so fifty clones pay fifty times the wait tax.
